name: cgrmcp
purpose: Read-only repository research over immutable public Git snapshots using CodeGraph-backed structural exploration.

connection.upstream_auth: bearer protected local MCP endpoint; tunnel-client forwards to it

backend.repository_scope: public HTTPS Git repositories accepted by the service allowlist, opened as immutable commit-pinned research snapshots

verified_acceptance: ChatGPT discovered exactly the four expected tools.
Public repository import and exact commit pinning succeeded.
Structural exploration succeeded on an indexable repository.
Traversal and non-HTTPS import attempts failed closed.
Host attribution confirmed cgrmcp journal activity increased while GitNexus remained unchanged.
reconstruction: Run the reviewed cgrmcp service on 127.0.0.1:3012 with its bearer boundary intact.
Run a separate tunnel-client profile/service bound only to the cgrmcp MCP endpoint.
Create a private ChatGPT plugin using Connection: Tunnel and bind it to the cgrmcp tunnel.
Use no ChatGPT-side OAuth/API-key auth when the tunnel path already enforces the local bearer boundary.
Verify exactly repo_open, repo_explore, repo_status, and repo_read are exposed.
Install/use the cgrmcp repository-research skill where the ChatGPT surface supports model-visible custom skills.
secrets_policy: Never commit tunnel IDs, OpenAI runtime keys, local bearer values, or credential file contents.
